reviews.comment: Attend lectures to get foundational material. Homework is generally harder than the exam questions. Exam problems were similar to problems in textbook; I found those to be the most helpful. I accidentally skipped a problem on an exam and let him know about it. He was very understanding and agreed to factor that in for the final grading.

This man made quizzes worth a large chunk of the grade and then only gave two all semester. The lectures for his classes consisted of him reading directly from the textbook and copying down the exact same diagrams from the book. The exams were a little hard to prepare for because the homeworks were irrelevant to some of the in-class material.

Terrible lecturer and bad at explaining things. Hard exams and a hard grader. Averages on every exam was around a 60. Made quizzes worth 10% of your grade but only gave 2 quizzes throughout the whole semester (one had an 20% average on it). I didn't learn anything in his class. DO NOT TAKE

Learned the textbook cover to cover, Read his lecture notes until burned into my head, and did not crack above a 78 on any midterm or final. Did not fail a single one either. If you put your best foot forward and work your butt off, at best you will pass. And if you are lucky to catch a few breaks, you might do better. Nice guy, insane exams.

I'll try to remain as unbiased as possible even though I have to retake this class because of him. He's not a terrible person, but you won't find yourself looking forward to his class. Lectures are extremely boring. People were always asleep. He's an old man so he struggled with technology. His exams were extremely hard. I didn't learn anything
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader
